sampling.hookPoint: after box2d world.Step — wrapper over instance property game.physics.box2d.update
sampling.coordinates: raw box2d physics coords (meters, y-up, negative space); screen px = (-32*x, -32*y)
sampling.inputInjection: synthetic KeyboardEvent(keyCode patched) on document, applied before Step by frame index

determinism.method: same input script re-run in a fresh browser context; per-frame max |Δpos| in meters (1m = 32px)
